name: flyrank-ml-internship
title_zh: 面试作品集里能直接跑通的机器学习实习档案
tagline_zh: 不是晒证书的简历附件，是 notebook、作业、毕业设计三件套齐活的项目仓库。面试官点开就能看代码、看结果。
tagline_en: Not a certificate wall—a repo with notebooks, assignments, and a capstone. Interviewers can click in and see.
desc_en: Machine Learning internship work for FlyRank AI, including notebooks, assignments, and capstone development.
why_zh: 把实习过程拆成可复现的单元，每步有产出。比单放一个 capstone 更能证明你从任务到交付的完整链路。
why_en: Breaks the internship into reproducible units with visible output at each step. Shows end-to-end delivery better than a lone.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 FlyRank 这一家公司的实习内容，不含通用 ML 教程或面试题。notebook 依赖该公司内部数据格式。
limit_en: Covers only FlyRank's internship scope; no generic ML tutorials or interview prep. Notebooks assume their internal data format—swap sources and.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A runnable ML internship portfolio with notebooks, tasks.
